newsitem.title: ITALY: Sirti firms in Milan on sale talk.
newsitem.headline: Sirti firms in Milan on sale talk.

text.p: Sirti, Italian state-controlled telecom holding Stet's cable-making unit, rose sharply on a weaker Milan bourse on a press report of an imminent sale.
At 0815 GMT Sirti stock was 3.89 percent up at 10,780 lire after opening at 10,900 lire and touching an early 10,920 high.
Financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore said that Stet, to be privatised in autumn after merging with telephone operator Telecom Italia, would put its 48.93 percent stake in Sirti on the market by the summer.
Pirelli SpA's cable-making unit Pirelli Cavi SpA, which with 3.07 percent is part of the shareholder syndicate which holds 52 percent of Sirti, has preemptive rights on the Stet stake.
Stet sources said the company had no comment to make on the press report.
Stet was 0.17 percent off at 7,795 lire while Pirelli SpA was 0.98 percent down at 3,730 lire.
The all-share Mibtel index was 0.5 percent down at 12,018.
